en.quote: I cried unto the LORD with my voice, and he heard me out of his holy hill. Selah.
en.riddle: I cried unto the LORD with my voice
en.speaker: David

he.quote: וְאַתָּה יְהוָה מָגֵן בַּעֲדִי כְּבוֹדִי וּמֵרִים רֹאשִֽׁי
